goal: Build a reusable Information Stream Engine and integrate a five-class attention demo into ALINA Control Center.
why: Separate information semantics from rendering so ALINA can manage simultaneous work without visual noise.
constraints: Semantic priority must not be derived from arrival order alone
Shared core must not import React, Workspace Engine or ALINA application code
Acknowledged alerts do not re-interrupt unless state changes
Agent activity remains distinct from the user primary stream
project_decisions: Visual prominence follows semantic priority and cost-of-missing
Workspace and Stream engines remain independent shared layers
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic ranking and attention selection exist
Five semantic stream classes render in ALINA
test_contract: Unit tests cover ranking, acknowledgement and interruption
App render test verifies five stream classes
Playwright verifies primary prominence and alert acknowledgement
open_questions: Should stream deduplication become executable in M0.4 or remain a hook for M0.4.1?
